questiontext.text: What is the formal definition of "Self-Reliance" in Civic Education?

generalfeedback.text: Self-reliance is using one's own talents, skills, and industry to provide for needs and achieve progress.

answer.text: The habit and ability of relying on one's own skills, labor, and resources to meet needs

feedback.text: Correct! Self-reliance is using one's own talents, skills, and industry to provide for needs and achieve progress.

answer.text: The habit of begging wealthy neighbors for pocket money every weekend

feedback.text: Incorrect. Self-reliance is using one's own talents, skills, and industry to provide for needs and achieve progress.

answer.text: Demanding that government officials deposit cash directly into citizens' accounts

feedback.text: Incorrect. Self-reliance is using one's own talents, skills, and industry to provide for needs and achieve progress.

answer.text: Refusing to ever speak to any other human being in your neighborhood

feedback.text: Incorrect. Self-reliance is using one's own talents, skills, and industry to provide for needs and achieve progress.
